themes.note: Frontmatter colors are the default Slate theme. Midnight and Light redefine the same CSS variables in src/index.css (:root[data-theme='midnight'], :root[data-theme='light']).

display.purpose: Marketing heroes only (homepage, Features, Developers), capped at about 18ch.

title.purpose: Panel headings in the app, such as the tag rack's "Tags".

label.purpose: Tags, theme options and button text.

caption.purpose: Dates, counts, footer and form hints, with tabular figures.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Menus and dialogs over the overlay.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Focused search and form fields, with a Stash Violet Bright border.

shadows.name: edit-bar
shadows.purpose: Left edge of the bookmark row being edited.

shadows.name: tag-edge
shadows.purpose: One-pixel underline on every unselected tag (a filter, not a box-shadow).

motion.name: state-quick
motion.purpose: Color, background and border changes on buttons, fields and nav.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Theme selector and secondary state changes.

motion.name: theme-swap
motion.purpose: Page background and text color when the theme changes; theme selector expansion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion, animations end at once and transitions collapse to short opacity fades.

breakpoints.name: toolbar-compact
breakpoints.purpose: Secondary toolbar buttons drop their labels.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar moves below the list, nav goes behind a menu toggle, padding tightens to 1rem.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Rows, trash and the consent banner restack.

components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.85rem; padding: 0 0.45rem 0 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong, rgba(255,255,255,0.17)); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-panel, #222128); color: var(--color-text-muted, rgba(242,241,245,0.56)); transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--color-primary-strong, #a48fff); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--color-accent-rgb, 109, 69, 255), 0.18); } .ds-search input { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; border: none; outline: none; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text, #f2f1f5); font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--color-placeholder, rgba(242,241,245,0.6)); } .ds-filter-chip { flex-shrink: 0; max-width: 180px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-primary-soft, rgba(109,69,255,0.16)); color: var(--color-primary-strong, #a48fff); font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: The signature shipping tag: pointed end, punched eyelet. Used for every tag; the active state is solid violet.
components.css: .ds-tag-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem; background: var(--color-panel, #222128); } .ds-tag { --tag-bg: var(--color-tag-bg, #33295a); --tag-ink-color: var(--color-tag-ink, #d4c8ff); --tag-ring-color: var(--color-tag-ring, rgba(212,200,255,0.4)); --tag-eyelet: var(--color-panel, #222128); --tag-point: 0.6em; position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.9em; margin-left: var(--tag-point); padding: 0 0.7em 0 1.05em; border: none; border-radius: 0 0.3em 0.3em 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at 0.4em 50%, var(--tag-eyelet) 0.16em, var(--tag-ring-color) 0.17em, var(--tag-ring-color) 0.24em, transparent 0.25em), var(--tag-bg); color: var(--tag-ink-color); font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 0 var(--color-tag-edge, #4a3d85)); } .ds-tag::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: calc(var(--tag-point) * -1 + 0.5px); width: var(--tag-point); background: var(--tag-bg); clip-path: polygon(100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 50%); } .ds-tag:hover { --tag-bg: var(--color-tag-bg-hover, #3d3170); } .ds-tag:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary-strong, #a48fff); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tag--active, .ds-tag--active:hover { --tag-bg: var(--color-primary, #6d45ff); --tag-ink-color: #fff; --tag-ring-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.3)); }

narrative.overview:
Tagstash is a tool surface for sorting and finding, and it looks like one. The interface is a tidy bench: a graphite ground, a few bordered panels laid on it, and the user's links in a single ordered index. Nothing on the bench competes with the work. Color is held back for the things the user acts on (the main action, the selected tag, the focused field) so the library itself reads first.

Components are calm and exact. Surfaces are flat and edged with hairline borders rather than lifted with shadows; state shows through color, border and a soft focus halo, never through movement. A bookmark row doesn't shift, scale or lift on hover; its actions simply appear. The one piece of identity allowed to show is the tag itself: a violet shipping tag with a pointed end and a punched eyelet, taken from the logo, used everywhere a tag appears.

The system ships in three themes that share one structure: Slate (neutral graphite, the default and the values in the frontmatter), Midnight (deep indigo, the original purple-leaning dark theme) and Light (cool paper). Every themed value is a CSS custom property in src/index.css; components never hardcode a theme-sensitive color. Playful or cartoon styling is ruled out: no mascots, illustrations or bouncy motion.
keyCharacteristics: Utility before identity; the library is the hero.
Flat, hairline-bordered panels on a quiet ground.
One saturated accent, Stash Violet, reserved for action and selection.
The shipping-tag shape is the signature and appears wherever a tag does.
One typeface (Public Sans) on one role scale: plain, open and legible at the small sizes a library lives at.
Three themes, one structure, all values through variables.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Stash Violet is the only saturated color in the chrome. It marks what the user can do next or what is currently selected; it never fills a panel, a header or a background.

rules.name: The Variables-Only Rule
rules.body: Every theme-sensitive color comes from a --color-*, --shadow-* or --theme-gradient variable. A hex value in component CSS is a bug in two of the three themes.

rules.name: The Real Contrast Rule
rules.body: Text is dimmed with a color variable, never opacity, so its contrast stays checkable. Text must clear 4.5:1 on its real background in all three themes.

rules.name: The Two Widths Rule
rules.body: Width is the hierarchy tool: headings and panel titles use the 118% display width, while everything a user scans (rows, tags, inputs, buttons) stays at normal width. Tags are never widened.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Counts, dates, pagination and version numbers use tabular figures so columns of numbers don't jitter.

rules.name: The Flat Bench Rule
rules.body: Panels and rows never cast shadows. A shadow means "this is floating above the page"; if it isn't floating, use a border or a tone.

rules.name: The Still Row Rule
rules.body: Rows and cards don't move on hover: no lift, no scale, no shift. Hover reveals actions and changes color only.

dos: Do route every color, shadow and background through the --color-* / --shadow-* / --theme-gradient variables, and check new work in Slate, Midnight and Light.
Do keep Stash Violet for primary actions, selection and focus, with at most one primary button per view.
Do use the shared tag component for every tag, and set --tag-eyelet to the surface color when a tag sits on something other than a panel.
Do separate surfaces with 1px hairlines and tone, and keep shadows for floating layers.
Do take every font size from a `--text-*` role token and every family from `--font-sans` / `--font-mono`; use tabular figures for counts and dates.
Do keep a visible 3px Stash Violet Bright focus outline on every interactive element, and honor reduced motion (transitions collapse to short opacity fades).
Do keep transitions short and functional (0.15s to 0.25s ease, color and border only).
donts: Don't make it playful or cartoonish: no mascots, illustrations or bouncy motion.
Don't move rows, cards or buttons on hover (no lift, scale or translate); reveal and recolor instead.
Don't put shadows on panels, rows or cards that sit on the page.
Don't introduce a second saturated accent, or use marigold for anything but favorites.
Don't hardcode theme-sensitive hex values in component CSS, or dim text with opacity.
Don't make a tag fill translucent; the point and body would show a seam.
Don't use inline style="..." attributes or injected <style> tags; the site's CSP blocks them. Styles live in same-origin CSS files.
Don't make cookie-consent Accept look more prominent than Decline.
